headline: St. Thomas Aquinas end Mercy's unbeaten run
dek: Mercy had not lost since opening day, and then lost at home to a St. Thomas Aquinas side without a win since August. Jacob Darwesh Lund-Iversen has scored nine of Mercy's sixteen goals from twenty shots, and both of their defeats have come on their own ground. Queens, level with them until then, won again.
displaced_by: Mercy lost at home to St. Thomas Aquinas as conference play opened, so Mercy and Queens are no longer level

pattern.text: Queens have scored 22 goals, more than any other programme, and nine different players have scored them; the attack is spread across the side rather than carried by one striker.

wire.line: Molloy scored more goals at home to Daemen than in all their earlier matches together.

findings.text: Daemen have conceded 29 goals, more than any two other programmes together, and are still without a win; the defeat at Molloy was their sixth.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Queens have won every match since the defeat at Holy Family, the latest at home to Roberts Wesleyan, and have conceded six goals all season against 22 scored.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Molloy have lost once, at home to Assumption, and have conceded four goals all season against eleven scored.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lorenzo Herrera has made 40 saves and conceded six for District of Columbia, whose home defeat to Lock Haven was their second.

last_match.line: St. Thomas Aquinas's other win also came on the road, at Dominican.

next_match.line: Both won their conference openers; St. Thomas Aquinas have yet to win at home, and Molloy have yet to lose away.
